dedupe_keys.name: titres et tarifs du reseau star

description: STAR publishes ticket products and fares for its Rennes public transport network. The documented fields include product identifiers, operator, ticket family, validity type, passenger count, quantity, price, VAT and sale status. These fare and validity attributes can supply cost rules for passenger choice and transport-demand simulation. The source explicitly retains some tickets that are no longer sold because they can remain on KorriGo cards. Sale status must therefore be checked before applying a product to a current travel scenario. This catalogue entry is distinct from the route topology and timetable resources. The metadata does not establish complete fare eligibility rules or the dates when each price applied. Coverage follows the provider-described Rennes network. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies ODbL licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related bus-route metadata supplies line identities.
